title: CiteTrace analysis_master
description: Stage analysis input. citations.evaluation_yn='Y' joined with sources(crawl_yn='Y') and queries. SoT: paper/figures/Appendix_E_Data_Release_Reproducibility.md §E.2.1. NOTE 1: 'domain' column is INTENTIONALLY omitted (deprecated in favor of 'category'). NOTE 2: release pool n=761,495; the 'clen >= 3000' threshold mentioned in Appendix E.2.1 is a downstream analysis filter applied in analysis, NOT a schema constraint here (DB analysis_master keeps all evaluation_yn='Y' rows).

clen.description: Crawl content length (chars). Analysis convention applies clen >= 3000 (Appendix B.7); not enforced here so that the full evaluable pool (761,495) round-trips.

cited_len.description: Length of cited_sentence (chars). Analysis convention applies cited_len >= 20 (Appendix B.7); not enforced here.

ipam_score.description: Intent-Purpose Alignment Matrix lookup (QI x SP). Appendix C.2

ssm_score.description: Source Reliability Matrix lookup (ST x SD). Appendix C.3

crawl_yn.description: Always 'Y' in analysis_master (analyses conditional on crawl-success pool, Appendix B.6)
